title: Scaling the memory wall using mixed-precision - HPG-MxP on an exascale machine
problem: Most scientific simulations are memory bandwidth-limited; applicability of mixed-precision to sparse matrix workloads remains unclear
motivation: Quantify mixed-precision benefits for bandwidth-limited sparse matrix applications on exascale systems
method: Optimized HPG-MxP benchmark implementation on exascale systems with algorithm enhancements for mixed-precision computation
key_novelty: 1.6x speedup from double/single-precision mixing on modern GPU supercomputers; first large-scale exascale validation of mixed-precision for sparse matrices
contributions: Optimized HPG-MxP benchmark implementation for exascale
Algorithm enhancements for mixed-precision sparse matrix operations
Demonstration of 1.6x speedup on modern GPU-based supercomputers
limitations: Limited to sparse matrix workloads (GMRES); applicability to other bandwidth-limited kernels unclear; specific exascale systems not named
